name: Welcome / Home
placement: Centered startup dialog; tabs above action and thumbnail groups.
controls: New Part/Assembly/Drawing, Open, recent thumbnails.
usage: Choose a document or reuse recent work; image is a 2020 reference, not a 2026 pixel specification.

name: Recent-document opening options
placement: Attached to a recent-document tile.
entry: Open dropdown or options on a recent item.
controls: Mode and configuration fields in the captured example.
usage: Choose how to load an existing document. Available modes depend on document type and release.

name: New document — basic
placement: Centered chooser with three document types; action buttons along bottom.
controls: Part, Assembly, Drawing; Advanced; OK/Cancel/Help.
usage: Select the required document category, then confirm creation.

name: New document — advanced
placement: Template categories across top, list left and preview right.
controls: Template tabs, template list, preview, OK/Cancel/Help.
usage: Choose a configured template rather than assuming every new file uses identical defaults.

name: No active document
placement: Top application commands, mostly empty viewport, Task Pane on right.
entry: Launch application without an open model.
controls: New/Open and resources.
usage: The editor frame remains available before any part, assembly or drawing is active.

name: Part workspace
placement: Horizontal command area above central model; manager dock on left.
controls: Features/Sketch/Evaluate tabs, history tree, graphics controls.
usage: Select model entities or tree items, launch a feature, and inspect the result.

name: Assembly workspace
placement: Assembly tools above graphics; component hierarchy at left.
controls: Insert Components, Mate and component actions in the captured toolbar.
usage: Manage occurrences and constraints; do not reuse a part toolbar indiscriminately.

name: Drawing workspace
placement: Sheet central; sheet/view tree left; annotation tools top; optional palette right.
controls: Annotation commands, views, tables, sheet tabs.
usage: Place and annotate model views within a drawing document.

name: CommandManager
placement: Usually below the menu/quick-access row in these references.
controls: Grouped icons, labels, flyouts and document-dependent tabs.
usage: Expose task-specific commands while keeping the model visible. Docking and customization alter placement.

name: Heads-up View toolbar
placement: Near the upper edge of the graphics area.
controls: View/navigation/display controls.
usage: Operate the camera and display without switching command tabs. Exact icon set varies.

name: Command search
placement: Upper-right application frame in the reviewed screenshots.
controls: Search field and dropdown.
usage: Find commands when their toolbar position is unknown; exact search modes need live validation.

name: Document/study tabs and status
placement: Along the bottom of the document frame.
controls: Model/study tabs; edit context, definition state and unit indicators.
usage: Keep active task and model state visible. Do not confuse sketch definition with cloud save status.

name: FeatureManager design tree
placement: Left manager pane below its tabs and filter.
controls: Expandable nodes, feature/component icons, selection and context menus.
usage: Navigate design structure and select model references. Labels and visible folders are customizable.

name: PropertyManager common structure
placement: Left manager pane while a command is active.
controls: Command title, confirm/cancel controls, input groups and selections.
usage: Collect inputs without a large modal obscuring the model; shared layout is an analytical pattern.

name: ConfigurationManager
placement: Left pane; configuration list above a separate display-state section.
controls: Configuration rows and active-state indicator.
usage: Choose a design variant; the reviewed GIF frame is a visual reference only.

name: Display States list
placement: Lower section of ConfigurationManager.
entry: Open ConfigurationManager and choose a display state.
controls: State entries and contextual properties.
usage: Switch presentation state; linking to configurations is a separate option.

name: DisplayManager / Appearances
placement: Left manager pane with its own sub-tabs and sorting control.
controls: Appearance hierarchy, sort order, scope groups.
usage: Inspect visual overrides at component, face, feature, body and part levels.

name: Task Pane / Resources
placement: Right-hand expandable pane next to a vertical tab strip.
entry: Select Resources in the Task Pane.
controls: Resource groups and utility links.
usage: Keep reusable content and supporting tools separate from command parameters.

name: Design Library / Toolbox
placement: Right Task Pane. Exact panel crop is not captured.
controls: Library and reusable-content navigation.
usage: Browse and drag suitable reusable design content into the document.

name: File Explorer task tab
placement: Right Task Pane. Distinct from the standalone PDM window.
entry: Select the File Explorer task tab.
controls: Folder/document browsing.
usage: Find files without leaving the CAD editor; integration can change its available tabs.

name: View Palette
placement: Right Task Pane alongside the drawing sheet.
entry: Open View Palette in a drawing.
controls: Model chooser, import options and view thumbnails.
usage: Drag a chosen model view onto a sheet; follow with projected views when appropriate.

name: DimXpertManager
placement: Left manager-tab family; exact content screenshot not captured.
controls: Tolerance-feature list and supported dimension/tolerance commands.
usage: Inspect manufacturing annotation structure. Availability is product-dependent.

name: Selection breadcrumbs
placement: Upper-left graphics area by default in the cited help; optionally at pointer.
entry: Select an eligible entity or tree node.
controls: Hierarchical references and contextual actions.
usage: Navigate selection context. The cited version excludes several selection/command states.

name: Confirmation Corner
placement: Upper-right graphics corner in the reviewed command views.
entry: Start a command with confirmation controls.
controls: Accept/cancel or command-specific exit controls.
usage: Finish or abandon the active operation without returning to the left panel.

name: Feature/component context menu
placement: Beside the clicked tree item or selected object.
controls: Context actions and sometimes a small icon toolbar.
usage: Expose actions appropriate to the selected entity and current mode.

name: Selection filters
placement: Bottom filter toolbar in the reviewed comparison.
entry: Show or use the selection-filter toolbar.
controls: Entity-type filter icons and filter-state controls.
usage: Restrict selectable entity types; 2025/2026 images show different icon sets.

name: Customize — Mouse Gestures
placement: Tabbed Customize dialog with command list and environment-specific mapping guide.
controls: Enable checkbox, gesture count, command search and guide wheels.
usage: Assign gestures separately for part, sketch, assembly and drawing contexts.

name: Sketch editing workspace
placement: Sketch toolbar above planar geometry; tree left and definition state below.
entry: Choose a plane/face and enter sketch editing.
controls: Sketch entities, dimensions, relations and Exit Sketch.
usage: Create a profile and constrain intended motion before using it in a feature.

name: Line Properties
placement: Left PropertyManager for a selected line.
controls: Existing relations, construction option and parameters.
usage: Inspect the line and its relations; direct parameters differ from dimensional design intent.

name: Smart Dimension launch and placement
placement: Sketch command area plus in-graphics dimension placement.
entry: Choose Smart Dimension and relevant entities.
controls: Entity selection and dimension placement.
usage: Apply an appropriate dimension; panel and popup vary with the selected dimension.

name: Modify Dimension popup
placement: Near the edited dimension or remembered popup position.
controls: Value/name, check/cross, numeric increments and command controls.
usage: Edit the value and confirm. A 2025/2026 comparison is included; exact positioning is not universal.

name: Add Relations
placement: Left PropertyManager; geometry selected in viewport.
controls: Selected entities, existing relations and available new relations.
usage: Select compatible entities and apply a relation appropriate to them.

name: Display/Delete Relations
placement: PropertyManager linked to highlighted sketch geometry.
controls: Relation filter, relation list and associated entities.
usage: Inspect and remove unwanted, dangling or conflicting relations; exact panel appearance not captured.

name: Boss-Extrude
placement: Left input groups with volumetric preview in the graphics area.
entry: Features > Extruded Boss/Base on a suitable sketch.
controls: From, Direction 1, depth, optional second direction and thin-feature controls.
usage: Set start/end conditions and depth, inspect preview, then accept or cancel.

name: Extruded Cut
placement: Uses the extrusion-command family; exact cut screenshot not captured.
controls: End conditions, depth and applicable scope options.
usage: Use selected contours to remove material; do not present boss-only options as universal.

name: Fillet
placement: Left selection/radius controls; blend preview and callouts on geometry.
entry: Features > Fillet, then choose suitable edges/faces.
controls: Selected items, radius, propagation and preview options.
usage: Choose references, set size, inspect blend preview and commit.

name: Loft
placement: Left PropertyManager with ordered selection groups.
controls: Profiles, start/end constraints, guide curves and preview.
usage: Organize section inputs and inspect the transition; the reference is a cropped panel comparison.

name: Boundary
placement: Left PropertyManager using directional selection groups.
controls: Direction 1, Direction 2 and preview-related options.
usage: Assign directional inputs; do not substitute a Loft panel with a changed title.

name: Hole Wizard — Type
placement: Left PropertyManager, Type tab.
controls: Hole type icons, standard/type/size, fit and end condition.
usage: Specify the hole definition, then switch to Positions. Options depend on selected hole type.

name: Hole Wizard — Positions
placement: Positions tab at left with placement interaction over a selected face.
controls: Face selection prompt, position points and supported sketch tools.
usage: Choose support geometry, place hole centers and constrain their positions.

name: Mate
placement: Left selection list and mate-type controls; selected faces in viewport.
controls: Standard/advanced/mechanical groups, selection list, alignment and mates list.
usage: Select compatible references, choose relation/alignment, then confirm. Connected screenshot is explicitly labeled.

name: Mate Controller launch
placement: Tree context menu beside selected mates.
controls: Mate Controller menu item.
usage: Launch reference only. The controller panel itself has not been captured or executed.

name: Drawing Model View
placement: PropertyManager linked to placement on the central sheet.
entry: Insert or select a drawing model view.
controls: Model choice, preview, orientation/scale and applicable import options.
usage: Choose the referenced model and place a view. Exact open panel screenshot is not captured.

name: Drawing view Properties
placement: Separate dialog reached from a drawing view or its PropertyManager.
entry: Right-click view > Properties or choose More Properties.
controls: View/model/configuration information and applicable properties.
usage: Inspect the referenced model/configuration and update the view as required.

name: BOM table on sheet
placement: Placed within the drawing sheet; BOM node in left tree.
entry: Insert or select a bill of materials.
controls: Rows/columns and model-linked property values.
usage: Document assembly/component data. The reference proves table placement, not every BOM configuration option.

name: Dimension PropertyManager
placement: Left dock when relevant dimensions are selected.
controls: Style, tolerance/precision, primary value, text and leader-related controls.
usage: Edit annotation properties; only shared properties apply when selecting multiple dimensions.

name: Weldments — Structural Member
placement: Left parameters; path/profile preview in graphics area.
controls: Standard/type/size, groups, alignment and Locate Profile.
usage: Select path segments and position a chosen profile before accepting.

name: Sheet Metal — Edge Flange
placement: PropertyManager paired with edge selection and a geometric preview.
entry: Sheet Metal > Edge Flange in a sheet-metal part.
controls: Edges, radius, angle, length and bend-position options.
usage: Select edges and define flange geometry. Actual panel screenshot remains a visual gap.

name: Interference Detection
placement: Left selected-components/results groups; overlap highlighted in graphics area.
controls: Components, Calculate, results and exclusion options.
usage: Calculate, select an interference and inspect its highlighted geometry. Release/load-mode options vary.

name: Measure
placement: Movable window over viewport with selected entities and in-graphics readouts.
entry: Evaluate > Measure and select suitable entities.
controls: Selected entity list and distance/area or other applicable results.
usage: Inspect measurements while geometry remains visible. Captured example also has a Modify popup open.

name: Simulation study tree
placement: Study-specific left tree associated with an analysis tab.
controls: Parts, Connections, Fixtures, External Loads, Mesh and results-related folders.
usage: Organize model assumptions and analysis setup; this is an add-in workspace.

name: Mesh context actions
placement: Popup beside the Mesh node in a Simulation study.
controls: Create Mesh, Mesh and Run, Apply Mesh Control and diagnostics.
usage: Choose a meshing action; this image does not show the numeric mesh-settings panel.

name: System Options — General
placement: Category tree left, search upper right and settings in center.
controls: Behavior checkboxes, categories and confirmation buttons.
usage: Configure application-wide preferences separately from document-specific defaults.

name: Document Properties tab
placement: Alongside System Options in the captured Options dialog.
entry: Tools > Options > Document Properties with appropriate context.
controls: Document-scoped properties; full content not captured here.
usage: Keep document-specific settings distinct from application-wide settings. Only tab placement is visually confirmed.

name: Dismissed Messages
placement: Nested category under Messages/Errors/Warnings; message table in main area.
controls: Dismissed-message rows and status-icon toggle.
usage: Review auto-dismissed messages and restore relevant prompts; source screenshot is 2026 context.

name: Customize Manager Pane Tabs
placement: Opened against the left manager-tab strip.
entry: Customize manager tabs using the version-specific UI.
controls: Checkbox list for manager tabs; required tabs disabled in screenshot.
usage: Control optional manager-tab visibility; 2026 reference, not proof of an identical older UI.

name: Display scaling optimization
placement: Prominent message dialog with three action choices.
entry: Version-specific launch on a monitor with a different resolution.
controls: Move to main monitor; change settings; keep layout; dismissal checkbox.
usage: Resolve a display-layout choice. Exact triggering logic has not been tested.

name: Import Complete notification
placement: Compact message crop; original screen position is not visible.
entry: After import completes in the source example.
controls: Success indicator, file/path text, Open Model and Open Location.
usage: Distinguish completion notice from the full import-progress/task-pane interface.

name: Vault File Explorer
placement: Windows navigation left, vault files upper right, file-detail area below.
entry: Open a configured PDM vault view.
controls: Vault commands, columns, folder navigation and detail tabs.
usage: Browse managed files and inspect selected-file state. Windows Explorer UI is not a CAD document page.

name: Data Card
placement: Lower file-detail area in the captured Windows vault view.
entry: Select a file and Data Card.
controls: Configurable metadata fields, configuration tabs and document status.
usage: Inspect/edit permitted metadata. Field names are deployment-specific examples.

name: File Preview
placement: Below vault file list; shown behind the History dialog.
controls: Model preview and applicable viewing controls.
usage: Review the chosen file without treating this as an editable CAD feature workspace.

name: History
placement: Separate window above vault file list/preview.
controls: Event table, version/user/date and details.
usage: Inspect stored iterations and transitions. No rollback or state mutation was executed.

name: Shortcut Bar
placement: Near the pointer; exact visual crop not captured.
controls: Mode-specific commands and command search.
usage: Use a compact customizable command set for part, assembly, drawing or sketch mode.

name: Orientation / View Selector
placement: Over the graphics area; precise dimensions depend on release and layout.
entry: Press Spacebar or use View Orientation.
controls: Standard orientations and custom views.
usage: Change the view independently from model geometry.
